## Purpose

`census-variable-code-evidence.csv` is the variable-level Census code evidence
register. It combines the generated Census schema with official ABS Census
Dictionary links where a public variable page exists.

This file is deliberately stricter than the generated schema appendix. The
schema appendix says what the current generator emitted. This register says
whether the emitted variable has an official ABS Dictionary source, whether
the current generator is using a small tested code set or a subset of a large
classification, and what still needs to be sourced before the variable is
treated as dictionary-accurate.

## Files

| File | Meaning |
|---|---|
| [`census-variable-code-evidence.csv`](census-variable-code-evidence.csv) | One row per generated Census variable. |
| [`schema-registers/schema-register-census.csv`](schema-registers/schema-register-census.csv) | Generated Census schema, sampled domains, and local PLIDA metadata matches. |
| [`variable-evidence-appendices/census-variable-evidence.qmd`](variable-evidence-appendices/census-variable-evidence.qmd) | Rendered generated-output evidence table. |

## Evidence Statuses

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `official_abs_dictionary_small_code_set_current_tested` | A public ABS Dictionary variable page exists and current tests constrain the generated values to an ABS-style small code set. Generated frequencies remain synthetic. |
| `official_abs_dictionary_large_classification_current_subset` | A public ABS Dictionary variable page exists, but the official classification is large and the current generator emits a subset, top-level representation, or compact implementation. |
| `official_abs_dictionary_dollar_code_current_tested` | A public ABS Dictionary variable page exists and current tests constrain generated dollar-value codes to official width/range plus supplementary codes. Generated amounts remain synthetic. |
| `official_abs_dictionary_numeric_or_year_current_tested` | A public ABS Dictionary variable page exists and current generated values are plausible numeric/year values, but the distribution is synthetic. |
| `local_plida_or_asgs_not_public_dictionary_page` | The generated field is local PLIDA/DIL or ASGS-style evidence rather than a public ABS Census Dictionary variable page. |
| `local_identifier_not_abs_dictionary` | The generated field is a package linkage identifier, not an ABS Census Dictionary category. |

## Use Rule

Use this register before adding Census examples or rebuild tests. A variable
with an official ABS source URL can be code-validated against that page, but
its generated distribution is still local unless an official distribution
source is attached separately. A variable marked as a large classification
needs a frozen machine-readable code table before future builds can claim full
dictionary accuracy.
